function.description: Calculate the final velocity of an object in motion given its initial velocity, acceleration and time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity of the object in m/s. This is a float type value.

acceleration.description: The acceleration of the object in m/s^2. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time for which the object is in motion in seconds. This is a float type value.

message.content:
Here’s a quick snapshot of some of the most talked‑about releases from the past few weeks (and a few that are hitting theaters soon). I’ve grouped them by genre and added a short note on why they’re worth watching.

| Release | Genre | Why it’s hot |
|---------|-------|--------------|
| **“The Marvels”** | Action / Super‑hero | Marvel’s latest ensemble film brings back Captain Marvel, Ms. Marvel, and introduces Monica Rambeau. It’s a high‑energy, visually stunning spectacle that ties together several MCU storylines. |
| **“Oppenheimer”** | Historical Drama | Christopher Nolan’s biopic about J. Robert Oppenheimer is a tense, character‑driven look at the creation of the atomic bomb. It’s already racked up rave reviews for its storytelling and performances. |
| **“Killers of the Flower Moon”** | Crime / Thriller | Martin Scorsese’s adaptation of David Grann’s book explores the murders of Osage Nation members in the 1920s. With Leonardo DiCaprio, Robert De Niro, and Lily Gladstone, it’s a powerful, gritty drama. |
| **“Past Lives”** | Romance / Drama | This indie love story follows two childhood friends who reconnect after decades apart. It’s praised for its subtle, realistic portrayal of longing and the passage of time. |
| **“The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes”** | Fantasy / Adventure | A prequel to the Hunger Games series, this film dives into the origins of the Games and the early life of President Snow. It’s a fresh take on a beloved franchise. |
| **“Spider‑Man: Across the Spider‑Verse”** | Animation / Super‑hero | The sequel to the wildly successful animated Spider‑Man film expands the multiverse concept with vibrant visuals and a deeper emotional core. |
| **“The Last Voyage of the Demeter”** | Horror / Thriller | A new take on the Dracula myth, this film focuses on the doomed ship that carried Count Dracula to England. It’s a tense, atmospheric horror that’s been getting buzz for its direction and score. |
| **“The Color Purple” (2024)** | Musical / Drama | A modern retelling of the classic novel, this film brings a fresh perspective to the story of Celie and her journey toward empowerment. |
| **“The Last of Us” (Film Adaptation)** | Post‑Apocalyptic / Drama | Based on the hit video game, this film adaptation explores the relationship between Joel and Ellie in a bleak, post‑pandemic world. It’s a must‑watch for fans of the game and newcomers alike. |
| **“The Great” (Season 3)** | Comedy / Drama | While not a movie, the third season of this Emmy‑winning series continues to explore the rise of Catherine the Great with sharp wit and historical satire. |

### Upcoming releases (next 2–3 weeks)

| Title | Release Date | Genre |
|-------|--------------|-------|
| **“The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes”** | 10 May | Fantasy / Adventure |
| **“The Last Voyage of the Demeter”** | 17 May | Horror / Thriller |
| **“The Color Purple”** | 24 May | Musical / Drama |
| **“The Last of Us”** | 31 May | Post‑Apocalyptic / Drama |

If you’re looking for something specific—like a particular director, actor, or genre—just let me know and I can narrow it down further!
